stops.note: 'something imitated'; Plato's Republic, Book 10, dismisses art as a mimēma, an imitation of an imitation
Richard Dawkins clipped mimeme to rhyme with 'gene' in The Selfish Gene (1976), for a unit of culture passed on by imitation; 'internet meme' followed in the 1990s-2000s

current_meaning: an idea or image copied and spread online; a unit of cultural transmission
